key_insight: A helical pipe passively homogenizes pneumatic conveying by inducing swirling motion that redistributes particles across the cross-section, narrowing particle-velocity differences.
engineering_relevance: Helical piping could improve pneumatic conveying at moderate gas velocities by reducing particle segregation and excessive speeds without needing more airflow.
method: CFD-DEM simulations of pneumatic conveying in straight vs. helical pipes
Compared gas/particle motion and cross-sectional particle redistribution
Evaluated changes in particle-velocity distribution and transport homogeneity
evidence_signal: The abstract reports simulation evidence that the helical pipe turns heterogeneous transport in a straight pipe into a more homogeneous state with a narrower particle-velocity distribution.
watch_item: Helical geometry may add pressure drop, bend-related wear, or installation complexity, so system-level tradeoffs need checking before deployment.
paper_title: Helical pipes homogenize particle transport in pneumatic conveying
